evals.prompt: После роста каталога GET /products/:id имеет p95 420 мс и создаёт 9 тысяч одинаковых чтений PostgreSQL в секунду; 1% product_id даёт 65% трафика. Команда добавила cache-aside в Redis с TTL 60 секунд. На 120 pod все экземпляры одновременно промахиваются после expiry, и один hot product вызывает до 300 запросов к database за секунду. Спроектируй production-grade исправление stampede и план доказательства эффекта. Локальный код можно менять, но production Redis, traffic и load test не трогай.
evals.expected_output: A freshness-oriented cache-aside design that proves the cache need, specifies complete product keys and bounded freshness, suppresses and fences concurrent fills, protects the origin, and defines comparable local/concurrency/failure proof without unauthorized production changes.
expectations: Uses PostgreSQL as authority, records an authority revision or generation for safe publication, and distinguishes a cache hit from truth.
Defines a complete versioned key including product identity plus every evidenced tenant, locale, currency, channel, authorization, or representation dimension, with collision/isolation tests.
Defines fresh and maximum-stale age, uses jitter only to spread expiry, and does not present TTL as invalidation or ordering correctness.
Collapses overlapping fills at the required process/distributed scope, bounds fill and waiter deadlines, fences stale publication, and protects origin concurrency during hot-key expiry.
Compares before/after p95/p99, throughput, origin/database QPS and load, cache/fill latency, value age, errors, and correctness under a representative expiry burst; hit ratio is not standalone proof.
Keeps production cache changes, traffic cutover, and load testing behind separate authorization and does not invent a performance improvement.

evals.prompt: PUT /products/42 успешно закоммитил version=118 в PostgreSQL, но Redis DEL вернул timeout, поэтому неизвестно, была ли invalidation применена. Параллельный GET начал читать version=117 до commit и может записать её в cache после DEL. API обещает read-your-writes для автора и не более 10 секунд stale для остальных. Диагностируй race и предложи реализацию/rollout; production flush и bulk invalidation не выполняй.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis of the committed-authority/ambiguous-invalidation race with a generation-fenced convergence design, explicit read-your-writes and staleness behavior, idempotent repair, and a production-safe rollout plan.
expectations: Treats PostgreSQL version 118 as authoritative and does not imply that a Redis timeout rolled back or disproved the committed write.
Models the invalidation timeout as ambiguous, retries only idempotent or generation-guarded work, and includes readback or durable reconciliation.
Explains the stale in-flight fill after invalidation and prevents version 117 from publishing over version 118 using a revision/generation fence rather than TTL alone.
Defines the complete key and all dependent variants plus a concrete read-your-writes path for the author and a measured 10-second maximum age for others.
Tests update-during-fill, timeout-before/after server execution, retry, repair, and degraded cache behavior, then compares latency and origin load without sacrificing correctness.
Leaves production flush, bulk invalidation, cutover, and load testing unexecuted pending separate authorization.

evals.prompt: GET /catalog/by-slug/new-camera кэширует 404 на 5 минут. Через секунду POST /catalog создаёт объект с этим slug и возвращает 201, но следующие GET продолжают получать cached 404. Нужны contract, исправление и тесты для negative caching в multi-region сервисе. Ничего не purge-ить в production.
evals.expected_output: A negative-cache contract that distinguishes authoritative not-found from errors, supersedes every regional/variant negative entry on create, bounds freshness, and proves create-after-404 convergence and failure behavior.
expectations: Names the create/read source of truth and caches only an authoritative 404, never a timeout or dependency error as not-found.
Defines a versioned, canonical slug key with complete tenant, authorization, locale, region, and representation scope where applicable.
Gives negative entries an explicit TTL/maximum age justified by create propagation and makes successful create invalidate or supersede the exact negative and related variants.
Handles missed or ambiguous regional invalidation with generation/versioning, durable delivery and reconciliation rather than assuming purge propagation is atomic.
Includes executable negative-then-create, concurrent GET/create, timeout, regional delivery-loss, tenant-isolation, and rollback tests.
Requires comparable latency/origin-load evidence and observed stale age, and preserves the production purge authority boundary.

evals.prompt: В multi-tenant SaaS GET /v1/reports/{id} кэшируется по ключу report:{id}. У tenant A и tenant B бывают одинаковые id. Ответ зависит от role, field-level permissions и locale; один пользователь уже увидел название отчёта другого tenant после cache HIT. Проведи read-only diagnosis и предложи безопасный cache contract и migration plan. Production не меняй.
evals.expected_output: A read-only isolation incident diagnosis that stops unsafe shared reuse, defines tenant/auth/policy-complete keys or post-cache authorization, and provides a versioned migration and falsification plan without production mutation.
expectations: Identifies the incomplete key as a cross-tenant authorization/privacy breach and treats the authoritative report and policy source separately from cached output.

Defines complete tenant, report, role/policy-version, locale, representation, and serializer namespace dimensions, or caches an authority-independent object and reapplies authorization after retrieval.
Avoids raw tokens or credentials as key material and defaults uncertain personalized/shared-cache behavior to fail closed, private, no-store, or bypass.
Defines freshness and invalidation for both report mutations and authorization/policy changes, including ambiguous failure and stale in-flight fills.
Provides collision, two-tenant/two-role, policy-change, create/update/delete, cold migration, rollback, and cache-outage tests plus observables for isolation failures.
Keeps diagnosis read-only, requires separate authority for production purge/cutover, and makes no unmeasured latency or load claim.

evals.prompt: Redis cache начал timeout-иться, evicted_keys резко вырос, MISS rate поднялся с 8% до 92%. Все 80 API pod fail-open идут в origin; PostgreSQL connections исчерпаны, p99 вырос с 350 мс до 8 секунд и пошли 503. Команда предлагает сразу увеличить cluster, поставить allkeys-lfu и разрешить бесконечные retries. Диагностируй failure chain и составь recovery/fix/proof plan, но не меняй production policy, размер cluster, traffic или database.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-backed cache-to-origin amplification diagnosis with bounded degraded mode, origin backpressure, eviction/capacity hypotheses, staged recovery, and representative before/after and failure proof under an explicit production authority boundary.
expectations: Connects Redis timeouts/evictions and unbounded fail-open fan-out to origin connection exhaustion and tail latency while retaining measurable competing causes.
Defines cache and database authority roles, complete key/freshness semantics, and safe stale or fail-closed behavior for correctness- and authorization-sensitive values.
Bounds cache deadlines, retries/backoff, fallback concurrency, queueing, circuit/shedding behavior, and recovery ramp so cache failure cannot multiply origin load without limit.
Requires value-size/memory/headroom, hot-key/slot skew, eviction, timeout, retry, origin QPS/concurrency/load, and p95/p99 evidence before choosing resize or LFU.

Defines representative outage, eviction, cold-start, hot-key, recovery, and rollback tests and compares latency, throughput, origin/database load, correctness, staleness, and errors; hit ratio alone does not pass.

Treats eviction-policy change, cluster resize, traffic cutover, flush/bulk invalidation, and load tests as separately authorized production actions and does not claim an improvement before a comparable benchmark.

evals.prompt: Checkout API имеет p99 900 мс при цели 500 мс. Репрезентативный trace показывает: чтение PostgreSQL занимает p99 6 мс, выполняется один раз на запрос и держит 40 QPS при загрузке database ниже 10%; 780 мс уходит на внешний payment provider. Команда всё равно предлагает Redis cache с TTL 5 минут для результата PostgreSQL и ожидает достичь цели. Проведи read-only design review и скажи, нужен ли cache. Production Redis, database, traffic и load tests не меняй.
evals.expected_output: A statistically sound no-cache verdict or bounded paired-trace measurement plan that preserves the supplied target, does not treat independently reported percentiles as additive or as upper bounds, stops before speculative cache design, and makes no performance claim or unauthorized production change.
expectations: Pins the user-visible p99 target, representative trace, PostgreSQL latency/QPS/load, and external-provider cost; concludes that the supplied evidence does not demonstrate enough removable PostgreSQL latency without treating independent percentiles as additive or as strict upper bounds; and requests paired trace evidence for exact quantification.
Treats PostgreSQL as authority only for the measured lookup and finishes with a no-cache verdict or bounded measurement plan instead of inventing a cached value, key, TTL, or invalidation path.

Stops before key, TTL/freshness, invalidation-race, and degraded-mode design because no cached value was selected, while noting that a remote cache would add correctness, isolation, and failure surface.
Routes investigation toward the measured external-provider latency while retaining competing causes and does not mislabel hit ratio as evidence of user-visible value.

Defines the comparable latency and origin-load evidence that would be required before reconsidering caching and makes no before/after performance claim without a candidate and representative benchmark.
Does not subtract independently reported percentile values as if they came from the same trace; uses paired trace-level or measured counterfactual evidence to quantify removable tail latency.
Keeps production cache changes, database changes, traffic cutover, and load testing behind separate authorization and preserves the read-only review boundary.

evals.prompt: В Go-сервисе внутри одного HTTP request функция loadPolicy(userID, locale) вызывается трижды с одинаковыми аргументами. Результат неизменен в течение request, работа занимает около 250 мкс, reuse между request не нужен, а в request state уже есть обычная map. Реализуй самое маленькое безопасное устранение повторной работы и один тест. Не добавляй Redis, background workers или отдельную observability-систему.
evals.expected_output: A minimal request-scoped memoization change that reuses the existing request state, keys only on response-varying inputs, preserves error behavior, and proves repeated/equivalent and distinct calls with one focused test without unrelated cache infrastructure or production ceremony.
expectations: Chooses request-scoped memoization and explicitly avoids cross-request, process-wide, or distributed caching because the prompt supplies no need for it.
Reuses the existing request map or surrounding ownership point rather than introducing a cache abstraction, service, dependency, or background lifecycle.

Keys on the evidenced response-varying inputs userID and locale, canonicalizing only when the surrounding contract requires it and not inventing tenant, authorization, serializer, or regional dimensions.
Uses request lifetime as the reuse boundary, so it does not add TTL, eviction, invalidation, distributed single-flight, rollout, or outage machinery.
Preserves the function's result and error semantics and proposes one focused runnable test proving one computation for repeated equal inputs and separate computation for a distinct key.
Centers the answer on the minimal implementation and test instead of emitting the full production cache report template.

evals.prompt: Публичный GET /assets/product/{content_hash}.webp возвращает одни и те же байты всем пользователям; hash меняется при любом изменении файла, Authorization и cookies отсутствуют. Legacy middleware сейчас выставляет Cache-Control: no-store. Проведи read-only review и предложи минимальный HTTP/CDN cache contract и проверку. CDN configuration и production headers не меняй.
evals.expected_output: A minimal immutable-asset HTTP cache contract using the content-addressed URL as the version boundary, explicit public freshness headers and only evidenced key variants, with header/cache-status verification and no unnecessary Redis, purge, invalidation, or authorization design.
expectations: Identifies the content-addressed asset bytes as the reusable value and the changing content hash as the version boundary, while treating the origin artifact as authoritative.
Recommends an explicit long-lived public freshness policy appropriate for immutable URLs, such as public max-age with immutable, and explains that no-store currently prevents reuse.
Uses the request URL plus only observed representation variants in the effective key and does not invent tenant, role, locale, authorization, or policy dimensions.
Uses a new content hash for changed bytes rather than requiring purge, outbox invalidation, authority-generation fencing, or Redis coordination for correctness.
Defines a focused check of response headers, repeated cache status/Age, byte identity, and origin-request reduction while leaving production CDN and header changes unauthorized.
Keeps the result proportional to the immutable HTTP asset case and avoids unrelated distributed-cache and database machinery.

evals.prompt: В Python-сервисе уже принятый in-process LRU кэширует exchange rate по ключу (base, quote) на 30 секунд, но результат также зависит от requested as_of date. Поэтому запрос USD/EUR за вчера иногда получает сегодняшний rate. Исправь root cause в общем key builder и добавь самый маленький runnable test. Не пересматривай доказанную необходимость кэша и production не меняй.
evals.expected_output: A root-cause key fix that adds canonical as_of to the shared key builder, preserves the existing LRU and cache contract, and leaves one focused collision test without reopening cache justification or adding unrelated infrastructure.
expectations: Identifies the missing as_of dimension in the shared key as the direct cause of cross-date value reuse.
Changes the shared key builder rather than guarding one caller and includes base, quote, and a canonical as_of representation in the existing namespace.
Preserves the accepted in-process LRU, 30-second freshness policy, and surrounding behavior unless code evidence requires another change.
Adds one focused runnable test proving equal canonical dates share a key and distinct dates do not return one another's rate.
Does not restart the cache-justification benchmark or introduce Redis, distributed locks, durable invalidation, CDN, tenant, authorization, or rollout machinery without evidence.
Keeps production unchanged and reports the local implementation/test state without claiming deployment or live proof.
